confirmedCause.causeClassification: Confirmed by the platform annotation. Progress/timing alone was initially inference and is not used as the sole proof. No Ubuntu image-causation claim is made.

assessment.recommendation: Change only jobs.regression.timeout-minutes from 60 to 90. Retain the same runner, dependency setup, complete pytest/notebook command, coverage threshold/output, strict checks, upload-on-failure, matrices, permissions, concurrency and release dependency gates.
assessment.basis: The confirmed 60-minute job limit interrupted a still-progressing full suite at 93%, before coverage finalization and all strict checks. Setup consumed 208 seconds; the full regression step consumed 3410 seconds before cancellation. A bounded extra 30 minutes permits the unchanged remaining work to finish rather than removing work.
assessment.inferenceAndLimits: Uniform-cost extrapolation from the observed 93% suggests about 64.1 total minutes through suite completion, before coverage finalization and strict checks. Test costs are uneven and strict-step time is unobserved; 90 minutes is reasonable headroom, not a guarantee or a pass claim.
assessment.fullCoverage: The original run did not establish a complete test pass or >=80% coverage; cancelled outputs must remain failed/incomplete evidence.
assessment.securityHooks: Full pre-commit/security hooks live in the separate quality job with its unchanged 30-minute limit. In original fa run that job passed 03:24:55-03:33:36, including both full repository hook report and every release-change hook step. This budget change does not alter or waive that gate.
assessment.runtimeSeparation: This is the outer CI job wall-clock limit only. Functional 2.5-second regression assertions, runtime/session/read deadlines, mission budgets, costs, coverage, security rules and production resource limits are untouched.
assessment.freshSourceRequirement: Any subsequent committed source needs fresh exact-source required checks and complete artifacts. Do not rerun, cancel, replace or relabel the preserved original fa attempt. Coordinate with the original current producers before advancing source.

repositoryInstructions.instruction: Run python tools/update_actions.py before committing workflow changes to refresh action versions.
repositoryInstructions.applicability: This helper hardcodes only .github/workflows/ci.yml and rewrites action SHA uses to latest mutable tags with SHA comments. It has no read-only/check or target-path option. It does not update the agent-release timeout. It was not run because the explicit scoped task requires preserving every existing action pin and prohibits unrelated updates/installs; do not claim it passed. Existing hosted quality invokes the unchanged helper as its own required gate.
repositoryInstructions.appropriateValidation: Exact parsed YAML comparison proves one changed field; all 73 uses lines and all other nodes are byte/structurally preserved. Pinned actionlint accepts the in-memory proposed workflow. No new implementation tests or suite execution are needed for this review.

limitations: The child did not open the cloud browser; the exact watchdog annotation is the parent reviewer primary UI observation, corroborated independently here by API job/check/run metadata and original logs.
GitHub connector direct job/check/annotation endpoints were unsupported; run/attempt jobs and commit check-runs were read through supported public endpoints. No unsupported action was bypassed.

No source edits, installs, tests, browser, local Chromium, execution probes, workflow operations, repository settings or public writes were performed. Only static parsing/actionlint and read-only retrieval ran.
